0.heading: Overview
refs: Acts 9:1 , Saul, going towards Damascus, is stricken down to the earth, and led blind to Damascus
Acts 9:10 , is called to the apostleship
Acts 9:18 , and is baptized by Ananias
Acts 9:23 , The Jews lay wait to kill him
Acts 9:29 , so do the Grecians, but he escapes both
Acts 9:31 , The church having rest, Peter heals Aeneas of the palsy
Acts 9:36 , and restores Tabitha to life.
